# The obee process dies right after the forge merged the second of three batch members, before the engine records that merge.
# The next obee run finishes the same run. It merges the third member once, and it does not call the forge merge again for the first two.
env REPO=o/r BASE=main OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com
batchsetup

! exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/batch.star
exists forge/crashed
grep -count=1 '^MergePR 1 ' forge/calls.log
grep -count=1 '^MergePR 2 ' forge/calls.log
! grep '^MergePR 3 ' forge/calls.log

exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/batch.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=1 '^MergePR 1 ' forge/calls.log
grep -count=1 '^MergePR 2 ' forge/calls.log
grep -count=1 '^MergePR 3 ' forge/calls.log

grep -count=3 '^MergePR [123] ' forge/calls.log
grep -count=1 '^gate$' forge/gate.log

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone'

-- forge/crash-after --
2
